title: Rating Input
content: Build star rating input component. Stars: 5 clickable star icons in row. Hover preview: fill stars up to hovered position. Selection: click to set rating. Display: filled stars for rating, outline for remaining. Half stars: optionally support half-star increments. Clear: option to clear/reset rating. Sizes: multiple size options.

variants.simple: Create star rating input with hover and click selection.
variants.detailed: Build star rating input component. Stars: 5 clickable star icons in row. Hover preview: fill stars up to hovered position. Selection: click to set rating. Display: filled stars for rating, outline for remaining. Half stars: optionally support half-star increments. Clear: option to clear/reset rating. Sizes: multiple size options.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive rating input component. Star icons: 5 Star icons from lucide-react (configurable count), inline-flex row with small gap. Hover preview: on mouse enter, temporarily fill stars up to hovered position, revert on mouse leave. Click to select: click sets rating, can click same to keep or configure to toggle off. Visual states: filled (text-yellow-400 fill-yellow-400), empty (text-gray-300), hover (text-yellow-300). Half-star support: detect click position within star (left half = 0.5, right half = 1.0), display half-filled stars, hover shows half increments. Clear rating: click selected rating again to clear, or explicit clear button/X. Read-only mode: display-only without hover/click interactions. Size variants: sm (h-4), md (h-5), lg (h-6), xl (h-8). Labels: optional text label ("Rate this product"), current rating text ("3 of 5 stars"). Custom icons: configurable icon (Heart, ThumbsUp instead of Star). Animation: subtle scale on hover, pop on selection. Tooltips: show rating meaning on hover ("3 stars - Good"). Form integration: works with react-hook-form, onChange callback, value controlled. Accessibility: keyboard navigation (arrow keys change rating), Enter/Space to confirm, proper ARIA (radiogroup with radio items, or slider). Disabled state: grayed out, no interactions. Average display: for showing aggregate ratings, support decimal display (4.3 stars). Distribution: optional bars showing rating distribution breakdown.
